s1.syndrome_frame: excessive sweating of the buttocks and sacrum with significant impact on daily life
salient_findings: excessive sweating of the buttocks, most severe at the intergluteal cleft and sacrum
previous successful treatment of axillary hyperhidrosis with 20% aluminum chloride
unsuccessful treatment of intergluteal cleft and sacrum with aluminum chloride
key_facts: 31-year-old male nursing student
history of axillary hyperhidrosis
excessive sweating of the buttocks
most severe sweating at the intergluteal cleft and sacrum
previous treatment with 20% aluminum chloride for axillary hyperhidrosis was successful
treatment of intergluteal cleft and sacrum with aluminum chloride was unsuccessful
uses absorbent pads due to severity of the condition
unable to attend work due to the condition
Minor starch-iodine test was performed to localize areas of overactive sweating
areas of significant sweating identified in the sacral region and intergluteal cleft

shortlist.label: Localized Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with excessive sweating localized to the buttocks, intergluteal cleft, and sacrum.

shortlist.label: Primary Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of axillary hyperhidrosis and current symptoms are consistent with primary hyperhidrosis.

shortlist.label: Compensatory Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's previous treatment of axillary hyperhidrosis may have led to compensatory sweating in other areas.

shortlist.label: Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: General term for excessive sweating, patient's symptoms fit this diagnosis.

shortlist.label: Generalized Hyperhidrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Although patient's symptoms are localized, generalized hyperhidrosis is a possible diagnosis given the severity of symptoms.
